channel.title: Dotty
channel.description: Updates for Dotty, a Mac menu bar app for 32x32 iPixel LED screens.

item.title: Version 1.0.4
item.description:
• A status now shows within about a second, even while a big clock is being sent to the screen. It could take 20 seconds before.
  • Fixed the clock starting up to a few minutes late after a status with a "back at" time.
  • A timer that runs out now goes back to the clock by itself, even with your Mac gone, instead of sitting on 0:00.
  • Media you were showing comes back after Dotty restarts.

item.title: Version 1.0.3
item.description:
• Clock faces that show the date now keep it right for a week without your Mac, instead of a day. After a week the time and the weekday stay right, and the day of the month slips until your Mac reconnects.
  • On those faces, seconds keep going for an hour after your Mac leaves, instead of a few minutes.
  • To keep Bluetooth quiet, those faces are sent less often, so their weather can lag by a couple of hours.

item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
• Your clock now keeps going without your Mac. Dotty sends the screen a whole day of your clock face as one animation that loops, so it carries on when your Mac sleeps or leaves the room. With your Mac away, faces with seconds show just the minutes, and the date and weather stay as they were last sent.
  • The screen now shows only what you pick. Dotty empties the screen's own playlist each time it connects and each time you pick something. This permanently deletes the factory demo and anything saved on the screen with the iPixel app, starting the first time this version connects.
  • Make your own statuses: New status… on the Status tab has a live preview, two lines, a colour and a real emoji, and keeps them with the others.
  • A new Praying status, with a mosque.
  • Name your screens under Settings, Screen. Blink turns a screen's display off and on so you can see which one it is, and scans list the nearest first.
  • Statuses stay up. Escape no longer ends one, Back soon, At lunch and Away only clear once you've really been away, and a status survives Dotty restarting.
  • Long pages in the menu window now scroll.

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
• Dotty now keeps itself up to date. It looks for a new version once a day, and Settings, Updates has a button to check now.
  • Settings shows which version you're running.
